name: What should I look for when hiring a contractor for drywall restoration in Pacifica?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when hiring a contractor for drywall restoration in Pacifica?

acceptedAnswer.text: When hiring a contractor for drywall restoration in Pacifica, look for experience with similar projects and a strong local reputation. Check for proper licensing and insurance for California. Ask for references and view examples of their past work, especially for texture matching. A reliable contractor will provide a detailed, written estimate, explain the restoration process, and offer a clear timeline. Communication and transparency are key throughout the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: When hiring a contractor in Pacifica, look for experience, local reputation, licensing, insurance, references, detailed estimates, and clear communication.
